title: Tere Bhai ki qamar toot gayi
body:
haaye abbas haaye abbas,
mere bhai, bere bhai,
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi,
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi..
(1) hai mujhe isski khabar, hoga ab neher pe kya x2
maine inna-illah, tere parcham pe likha...
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(2) kaise dhoondu main tujhe, noor aankhon me nhi x2
dagmagate hai kadam, zor saanson me nhi..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(3) aisa lagta hai mujhe, jism hai jaan nhi x2
zinda rehne ka mujhe, koi armaan nhi..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(4) jo thi jeene ki talab, dilse woh kab ki gyi x2
haaye jaate hi tere, aas zainab ki gyi..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(5) kaise rudaad teri, uss hazina se kahu, x2
mashq kis tarha chhidi, kya sdakina se kahu..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(6) muntazir thi teri, woh taraayi abbas, x2
aa rha hun main bhi, jaao bhai abbas..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(7) aur faujo ne kiya, tangg gheraa bhai, x2
tere jaane se hua, aur andhera bhai..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(8) tumpe qurbaan karu, yeh taraayi kehdo, x2
jaate-jaate bhaiyya, mujhko bhai kehdo..
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
(9) ek-ek lafz bana, sheh ki gurbat ki daleel, x2
padhke rota hai "waseem", likhke roya hai "faseel"
teri darya se sada aate hi x2 tere bhai ki kamar toot gyi
aye mere sher tere jaate hi, tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi...x2
